lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin. The arrangement forms a semi-regular grid with higher density clusters located in the lower-central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, functioning as anchor nodes. These intersections are most prominent in the mid-body section where the vertical light gradients are most defined.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition where the dorsal surface lightens and the area immediately ventral to the ridge enters shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance blobs, distributed primarily along the anterior half and the base of the fin surface.
